description: Fold or unfold a foldable iPhone simulator (iPhone Duo) or a foldable Android emulator into the closed, half-open, or open pose. iOS sends a simulator HID hinge event, then reads the hinge angle back inside the simulator to confirm it, and can follow timestamped angle keyframes; Android sets the emulator console posture, then confirms the device state the guest commits and reports the angle read from the hinge sensor, which can differ from the AVD profile's per-posture angles, and dismisses the lock screen a fold to the cover display can raise. On iOS a pose change moves the app to a different panel with a different point size; on Android a fold to or from closed moves the app between the cover and inner displays, and any pose change can reshape the app window, whose size the next snapshot reports. Either way every ref and coordinate from before it is stale: re-snapshot after this command. Taps, long presses, and scrolling target the app window on its current panel in closed, half-open, and open poses. Simulator and emulator only; iOS requires the iOS simulator SDK; Device Hub and host Accessibility permission are not required. An iOS simulator in a scoped simulator set folds the same way as one in the default set. Times out after 255s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

keyframes.description: Piecewise-linear hinge motion. Start at 0ms; strictly increasing timestamps, up to 60000ms. Repeated angles create holds. Mutually exclusive with pose.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

pose.description: Instant preset; mutually exclusive with keyframes.

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

name: fold
